title: LRAgent: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA LLM Agents
authors: Hyesung Jeon; Hyeongju Ha; Jae-Joon Kim
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache compression, LoRA / Multi-adapter

problem_statement.en: Multi-LoRA agent systems share a pretrained backbone but independently compute and store KV caches for the same long, tool-augmented trajectories. Existing sharing methods do not exploit the adapter structure, leaving substantial memory and redundant-prefill overhead while risking loss of role-specific behavior under direct sharing.
problem_statement.zh: 多 LoRA agent 系統雖共用 pretrained backbone，仍會針對相同的長篇 tool-augmented trajectory 分別計算與儲存 KV cache。既有共享方法未利用 adapter 結構，因此仍承受顯著的 memory 與冗餘 prefill 開銷；若直接共享，亦可能損害 role-specific behavior。

key_innovation.en: LRAgent decomposes each cache into a shared base component from pretrained weights and a low-rank adapter component from LoRA weights. BaseShared retains a per-agent LR cache, BaseLRShared shares that cache through a shared-A multi-LoRA design, and Flash-LoRA-Attention reconstructs adapter contributions without materializing them at full dimension.
key_innovation.zh: LRAgent 將每份 cache 分解為由 pretrained weights 產生的共享 base component，以及由 LoRA weights 產生的 low-rank adapter component。BaseShared 為各 agent 保留獨立 LR cache；BaseLRShared 透過 shared-A multi-LoRA 設計進一步共享該 cache；Flash-LoRA-Attention 則無須將 adapter contribution materialize 至完整維度即可完成重建。

key_improvements.en: Against Non-Shared caching, BaseLRShared improves throughput by up to 2.46x and reduces TTFT by up to 4.44x. BaseShared and BaseLRShared reduce KV-cache memory by nearly one third while limiting the average accuracy drop to at most 0.7 and 1.5 percentage points, respectively.
key_improvements.zh: 相較 Non-Shared caching，BaseLRShared 的 throughput 最高提升 2.46x，TTFT 最高降低 4.44x。BaseShared 與 BaseLRShared 均將 KV cache memory 降低近三分之一，且平均 accuracy drop 分別不超過 0.7 與 1.5 個百分點。

reuse_metric.en: Relative to Non-Shared caching, BaseShared limits the average accuracy drop to at most 0.7 percentage points and BaseLRShared to at most 1.5 percentage points across HotpotQA and ScienceQA.
reuse_metric.zh: 相較 Non-Shared caching，在 HotpotQA 與 ScienceQA 上，BaseShared 的平均 accuracy drop 不超過 0.7 個百分點，BaseLRShared 則不超過 1.5 個百分點。
